name: Kankyuu Goujuu
source:
"Her destination is where the scent of obscenity wafts from......"

Shinonome Mari dreams of becoming a veterinarian since she was a child, and now she's earnestly studying at a university to fulfill that dream.

The teaching staff is very confident of her because of her diligence and good grades, but Mari actually has a secret hobby which she can't tell others. 

To satisfy her more than average sex drive (at least that's what she thinks), she visits a certain place frequently. 

"That place" is where she's gazed at longingly, and where her nasal cavity is engulfed with a titillating smell. 

When she masturbates in "that place", she experiences an unmatched supreme bliss. It wouldn't be strange to call it her hobby as it changed her everyday life, and as she lost her self restraints, she gradually escalated her deeds.

And then today, she is headed to "that place" again--

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet/cyclet_main.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
“她的目的地，就是散发着淫秽气息的地方……”

东云麻里从小就梦想成为一名兽医，现在为了实现这个梦想，她正在大学认真学习。

由于她的勤奋和成绩好，老师们对她很有信心，但玛丽其实有一个不能告诉别人的秘密爱好。

为了满足她超乎常人的性欲（至少她是这么认为），她经常去某个地方。

“那个地方”是她憧憬的地方，也是她鼻腔里弥漫着诱人气味的地方。

当她在“那个地方”自慰时，她体验到了无与伦比的至高无上的幸福。说这是她的爱好并不奇怪，因为它改变了她的日常生活，而随着她失去自我约束，她的行为逐渐升级。

然后今天，她又要去“那个地方”——

[译自[url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet/cyclet_main.html]官方网站[/url]]
